THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
 
BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS MONTHLY MEETING 
 
Kennedy Manor 
Community Room  
175 Broad Street 
Pawtucket, RI 02860 
 
October 21, 2026, at 4:00 P.M. 
 
AGENDA  
 
1. Meeting called to Order & Roll Call 
 
2. Resident and Public Concerns on Agenda Items only 
*All public comments will be limited to three (3) minutes per person to speak. 
Time cannot be yielded to others. Time is allocated for the Board to listen; 
they will not engage in discussion. 
 
3. Approval and VOTE of Minutes from September 10, 2026 
 
4. Correspondences – Discussion, Approval and Vote 
• None 
 
5. Executive & Deputy Directors Monthly Report – Report by Executive & Deputy 
Directors to the Board concerning major ongoings of the PHA since the last Board 
meeting. 
 
6. Approval and Vote of the Consent Agenda - All Department Reports 
 
•  (6A) Leased Housing Report – Report summarizes the monthly activities 
within the Housing Choice Voucher Program. 
•  (6B) Public Housing Report - Report discusses the status of occupancy, 
inspections, annual recertifications, application count, move ins, move 
outs, and calculation of occupancy formula for the previous month.
THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
•  (6C) Legal Status Report – Report concerning the status of evictions and 
other ongoing legal proceedings. 
•  (6D) Financial Report – Report reviews the prior month’s finances for all 
departments. 
•  (6E) Security Report – Report highlights all monthly Security activity that 
occurred within the PHA. 
•  (6F) Resident Services Report – Report discusses grants being applied for, 
resident events occurring and attendance at previous events, as well as 
some highlights from each Resident Services Program that is offered. 
•  (6G) Other Non-Public Housing Report - Report discusses the status of 
occupancy, inspections, annual recertifications, application count, move 
ins, move outs, and calculation of occupancy formula for the previous 
month. 
•  (6H) Facilities and Capital Projects Report – Report covers any scheduled 
operating work-related activities or current capital improvements. 
 
 
7. New Business  
• 2027 BOC Meeting Schedules/Monthly & Bi-Monthly 
 
Resolutions – Discussion, Approval and Vote on the following resolutions: 
• Resolution #1428 - Acceptance of Audited Financial Statements for Park 
Manor, LLC for the Fiscal Year Ended March 31, 2026 
• Resolution #1429 – Adopting a Temporary Relocation Meal Allowance 
Policy 
• Resolution #1430 – Adopting the Capital Fund Payment Processing and 
Accounting Policy 
• Resolution #1431 – Approval of 2027 Housing Choice Voucher (HCV) 
payment standards 
• Resolution #1432 – Approval of 2027 Public Housing Flat Rents and Utility 
Allowance for Galego Court 
• Resolution #1433 – Amendment to Resolution #1311 Non-Union Employees 
Vacation and Sick Policy
THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
8. Other Business 
 
• Executive Session (R. I. General Laws section 42-46-5(a)(1)& (a)(2)) – 
Discussion and/or Approval and Vote on: 
 
• Deputy and Executive Director Contract 
 
9. Adjournment – Vote 
 
 
 
Next Meeting: Fogarty Manor, Community Room, Wednesday, December 16, 
2026, at 4 pm. 
 
Agenda Posted at: Rhode Island Secretary of State Open Meetings, Pawtucket 
Housing Authority Properties and Pawtucket City Hall on Friday, October 16, 2026.
